<!--
SHARED FIRST-LOAD NOTICE for the Data Academy lessons — pull it into a lesson with Quarto's include
shortcode, naming this file (see just above the example-data include in find.qmd for a working example).
Put it immediately before the first code box on the page.

NOTE: do not write that shortcode literally in this file, not even inside a comment like this one.
Quarto resolves include shortcodes in a text pass that does not respect HTML comments, so a file naming
itself includes itself, and the render dies with "Maximum call stack size exceeded".

Every lesson has to set the same expectation: webR downloads R on first use, so the first box can sit
there doing nothing for up to a minute on a slow connection, and a learner who does not know that reads
it as a broken page. The guide requires the message on every lesson; keeping the words in one place stops
the four copies drifting apart, as they already had.
-->

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
**If nothing happens at first,** R is still waking up — up to a minute the first time, on a slow
connection. A small **spinning circle** on a box means it is working. Wait for it to stop.
:::
